card.name: Contrast words after a reassuring statement
card.fires_on: Contrast words such as However, although, except and despite that come right after a positive or reassuring claim. They introduce a caveat or exception.

modes.label: Sentence-opening However
modes.description: The word However starts a new sentence after a statement that nothing bad or notable happened.
modes.example: << However>>, serious adverse events of hypertension have been

modes.label: Mid-sentence concession
modes.description: Although, except, despite, or a comma introduces an exception after a positive clause.
modes.example: generally perform well,<< although>> the performance of some of them degrades
